correctness.rationale: The update depends only on occupied color supports on each shore and is lifted exactly to tagged representatives. Independently enumerated all 15^3=3375 triples with per-original-color transport, reproduced F^10=F^6, entry histogram (620,248,658,739,641,391,78), 620 initially periodic support triples and 619 primitive four states by support. Grouping 619 by sorted support sizes reproduced all 16 coefficients, e.g. coefficient 4 for (1,1,2) and 42 for (2,2,2). Surjection count S_j(n) supplies all-size labelled coefficients. F^10=F^6 does not follow from mere support equality; per-color transport was tracked independently. This establishes a finite exhaustive size-independent lemma, not a small-n extrapolation.
